models.name: Logistic regression · differential entropy
models.description: Standard baseline for SEED-style emotion recognition: DE features per band and channel, L2-regularised logistic regression.

models.name: SVM (RBF) · differential entropy
models.description: Widely used non-linear baseline for EEG emotion recognition.

models.name: Random forest · differential entropy
models.description: Tree ensemble on DE features; robust to feature scaling and gives a non-linear reference.

models.name: Shrinkage LDA · log band power
models.description: Classic BCI classifier (regularised LDA) on spectral band power.

models.name: Gradient boosting · log band power
models.description: Histogram gradient boosting (LightGBM-style) on band power.

models.name: Riemannian tangent space + LR
models.description: Covariance matrices → tangent space → logistic regression. A strong, training-light state-of-the-art baseline in EEG decoding.

models.name: EEGNet (braindecode)
models.description: Compact CNN for EEG (Lawhern et al., 2018).

models.name: ShallowFBCSPNet (braindecode)
models.description: Shallow ConvNet inspired by filter-bank CSP (Schirrmeister et al., 2017).

models.name: EEG Conformer (braindecode)
models.description: CNN + self-attention transformer for EEG (Song et al., 2023).
